hypothesis: Identical sampled inputs and nonperturbing traces localize the earliest divergence between Unity and the independent Vulkan harness.
next_step: Use invocation identity and per-site occurrence to pair records, then compare logical Load coordinates and value bits separately. Preserve bounded private traces and require output-parity controls. Prior source-free Unity Vulkan runs did not establish the backend; do not repeat this expensive run without a changed discriminator.
result: Authenticated pair 0: Unity OpenGLCore and Mesa CPU Vulkan. Source and butterfly GPU readbacks each had 0 mismatches across 32,768 texels. Instrumentation preserved output in each backend under existing tolerance. Pass zero: 64 jointly written pixels, RGBA mismatch counts [63,62,63,63], zero nonfinite. Trace missing and extra coordinate records were [63,252,64] each at the three Load sites. Zero records had equal per-coordinate multiplicity for value comparison, so zero value-bit mismatches provides no value-parity evidence. Unity NUnit passed 2/2; final numeric parity gate exited 1. Same-backend Unity Vulkan and Android were not tested.
